_doc: #1958 what the regenerated site no longer carries compared with data/parity-baseline-1958.json, each with the reason. The site mirrors the SuperApp declaration (aa_cloud-superapp/build.json and the ac_* build.json files of cloudy-u-android); an entry here is something that declaration dropped or moved, never something the web side removed by itself. scripts/webapps-parity.test.ts fails on any loss not listed here AND on any entry listed here that is still present (a stale declaration).
